author: Mark Atwood
text:
Resolved partially: added InjectableBackend + burn-on-read canary test (chat-server's first redaction-discipline regression guard). Filed JMAP-x2gd.102 for the duplicate-Direct cleanup test which requires additional harness machinery.

## What landed

1. **`InjectableBackend`** (tests/common/mod.rs:740-997) — a MemoryBackend wrapper with per-(type, op) fault-injection mirroring the canonical jmap-mail-server FaultyBackend pattern. Supports two injection targets today: `(O::TYPE_NAME, "destroy")` and `("Message", "expire")`. Sibling-wrapper-not-extend-FaultyBackend was chosen because the existing two `FaultyBackend` tests at integration.rs:5280/5290 depend on its always-fails behavior; growing FaultyBackend would have required migrating those tests.

2. **`INJECTABLE_BACKEND_CANARY`** const — identical literal to mail-server's `FAULTY_BACKEND_CANARY` so the visible-footgun shape stays consistent across the workspace.

3. **`message_set_burn_on_read_expire_failure_redacts_backend_display`** test (integration.rs, after `memory_backend_expire_message_idempotent_on_missing`) — drives a Message/set update with readAt against an InjectableBackend that fault-injects expire_message, asserts the canary is absent from the wire, and positive-controls that description == jmap_server::SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC. Mirrors mail-server's set_per_id_server_fail_redacts_backend_display_update pattern.

## What was split off

The duplicate-Direct cleanup canary test (chat.rs:363 redaction site) was filed as JMAP-x2gd.102 because triggering that redaction site requires more than fault-injection alone: the handler's pre-fetch + race-detection logic only reaches destroy_object cleanup when a duplicate appears BETWEEN the pre-fetch and the post-create re-fetch. Sequential test calls don't exercise the race. The .102 bead lays out two harness options (RaceDuplicateBackend wrapper vs InjectableBackend.create_object phantom-insert).

## Gates

- cargo test -p jmap-chat-server: 176 integration tests passing (was 175, +1 new)
- cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-server --all-features --tests -- -D warnings: clean
- RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p jmap-chat-server --no-deps --all-features: clean (rustdoc resolves the intra-doc links)
- cargo fmt --all: clean

Diff: 2 files, +344 lines (all new code: harness wrapper + 1 test). No existing tests modified.

Partially closes JMAP-x2gd.99. Remaining duplicate-Direct cleanup canary tracked under JMAP-x2gd.102.
